digest.component_or_area: Pydantic Agent run accounting and compatibility seams
propositions: Successful multi-attempt Agent runs must report aggregated usage (requests and output_tokens summed across all attempts) in memory, telemetry, and a single durable JSONL row, never per-attempt rows.

Validation-failure exhaustion must re-raise the identical original Rebar StructuredOutputError object by walking the UnexpectedModelBehavior cause chain through ToolRetryError and ModelRetry, preserving its subtype and identity.

Repeated-truncation or output-size exhaustion with a bare ModelRetry (no __cause__) must construct and surface a fresh UnretryableOutputError as the defined fallback when no Rebar object is found on the cause chain.
Terminal failure must preserve consumed requests, tool calls, and provider-reported tokens in diagnostics without creating fictional usage for calls that reported none.
When parse-failure artifact capture is enabled, only terminal failure writes an artifact containing the complete final provider response, even if earlier retries omitted responses.

Usage schema and JSONL rows must remain byte-compatible with historical data, containing no new request-budget field like candidate_requests, and verify existing aggregates retain complete operation counters.
